newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FORECAST- Consensus survey of Brazilian indicators.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Consensus survey of Brazilian indicators.

text.p: The following are consensus forecasts from a Reuter survey of Brazilian economic indicators taken from eight Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro brokerages and research firms. Also included are current market rates for dollar and interest rate futures over the next three months.
Each are updated twice monthly after the government statistical agency IBGE releases industrial activity figures early in the month and the trade balance later in the month.
